messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Heads-up: a few edge cases popped up in review prep - LOA, mid-cycle hires, and contractor->FTE conversions. Quick sync here so managers have consistent guidance.
Ben (Manager - Core Platform): Thanks. For LOA folks I normally do a short snapshot + note dates. Does People Ops want a standardized label so calibration can filter?
Carla (Manager - ML): Agreed on a label. Also for hires <90 days I usually include ramp objectives and mark as 'insufficient data' in the rubric. 
Aisha (People Ops): Proposal: add a required dropdown with options: "Full cycle", "Partial data (LOA)", "New hire <90d", "Contractor->FTE". Each selection must have a 1-line rationale in the free text box. Provisional rating allowed but must be flagged for calibration.
Raj (HRBP): That sounds good. Operational note: provisional ratings flagged will be shown as "Pending calibration" in the packet and treated as deferred during finalization.
Ben (Manager - Core Platform): Clarify: what threshold defines LOA for 'Partial data'? 
Aisha (People Ops): Use >30% of the review period as the heuristic. I'll add guidance text on the form: "If employee had >30% leave, choose Partial data and add 1-2 sentence summary."
Carla (Manager - ML): Pls also add a small checkbox: "Flag for calibration" so it's easy to search.
Aisha (People Ops): Will do. Draft guidance to include: "For new hires (<90 days), select 'New hire <90d' and include ramp goals + any observable contributions. For contractors who converted, note conversion date and treat as partial data."
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: forms due in 48 hours. Review guide: https://docs.internal/redwood/reviews/forms :bell: 
Ben (Manager - Core Platform): Another edge: what about people who were on short-term performance improvement plans that ended mid-cycle? Should that be a special flag?
Raj (HRBP): Good catch. Add a separate flag "Performance plan during cycle" (non-public metadata) so calibration can see it. Managers don't need to write details in the main rationale, just tick the flag and coordinate w/ HRBP for context.
Aisha (People Ops): Updated checklist I'll add to the forms page and email: 1) Choose category dropdown 2) Add 1-line rationale 3) Check relevant flags (LOA, PIP, Conversion) 4) Attach evidence links 5) If assigning provisional rating, click "Flag for calibration" and notify HRBP for slot.
Carla (Manager - ML): Could People Ops also auto-populate conversion/leave dates using HR data where available? Saves manual typing.
Aisha (People Ops): We're pulling HRIS lookup for dates now; if data exists we'll pre-fill the date field and manager can confirm. If no data, manager must input.
Ben (Manager - Core Platform): Sweet. Last ask: if a manager misses the form deadline because a direct report is on leave, can we extend?
Raj (HRBP): Yes - managers can request a 1-week exception via the Helpdesk form. We will include an "Exception request" link on the forms page. Exceptions are granted case-by-case.
Aisha (People Ops): I'll push the form change (dropdown + flags + guidance) and email the updated how-to in ~20 minutes. If anyone wants a quick walkthrough before I publish, DM me. :thumbsup:
